args.title: checkout-api prod unhealthy on v2.3.1 — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary:
checkout-api began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) after the latest deploy of v2.3.1. Observed error rate was ~18% with healthy=false. Root cause not yet determined; v2.3.1 status is unhealthy and v2.3.1-rc (staging) was also unhealthy, so the newest production release with a known-healthy status was v2.3.0.

ACTION TAKEN: Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first rollback attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, leaving a mixed state (us-east on v2.3.0; us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1). A retry completed successfully: all three regions now report v2.3.0, healthy=true, error rate down to ~0.2%.

FOLLOW-UP: Service is recovered and monitored. v2.3.1 should not be re-deployed to production until the health check failures are diagnosed and fixed. Recommend reviewing the v2.3.1 changeset and the orchestrator error seen during the first rollback attempt.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
The incident did get created (INC-0001) — the timeout was on the response, not the creation. No retry needed, and reusing the idempotency key would have returned the same record anyway.

## Summary

**Done — checkout-api recovered and incident opened.**

**Diagnosis:** v2.3.1 was deployed to all three production regions and failing health checks (`healthy: false`, error rate ~18%).

**Rollback target:** v2.3.0 — the most recent production release with a healthy status. Note that v2.3.1-rc appeared in the history but was a staging deployment and was itself unhealthy, so it was not a valid target. Since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production, this rollback did not require change-manager approval.

**Execution — worth flagging:** the first rollback halted partway with an orchestrator error, leaving a **mixed state**: us-east on v2.3.0, while us-west and eu-west were still on the failing v2.3.1. I verified the actual per-region state rather than trusting the deploy log, then retried, which converged all three regions to v2.3.0.

**Verification:** all regions now on v2.3.0, `healthy: true`, error rate down to ~0.2%.

**Incident:** INC-0001, SEV2, opened for checkout-api with a summary of the failure, the rollback, the partial-failure and retry, and follow-ups. The create call timed out, so I listed incidents to confirm it had actually landed before deciding not to retry.

**Recommended follow-ups:** diagnose the v2.3.1 health check failures before any re-deploy, and investigate the orchestrator error that interrupted the first rollback — a silent partial rollout across regions is a risk in its own right.
